title: Letter to Emperor Theodosius
author: Epiphanius of Salamis
blurb: Epiphanius begs the emperor to remove religious images, and explains why Christ must not be painted.
first_english_note: Original English Translation of Epiphanius of Salamis’s Epistula ad Theodosium imperatorem — new OET from PG 41–43 Greek (Khazarzar). Modern English syncs (incl. Pusey-PD / Greystone / Lunn / Hill) were not used as wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew densify. SERIES CLOSEOUT.
